newsitem.title: USA: CapStar files to offer 5 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: CapStar files to offer 5 mln shrs.

text.p: CapStar Hotel Co said Wednesday it plans to file to offer five million shares of common stock.

Net proceeds are to be used to pay for the cash portion of the purchase price of eight hotels it said it plans to acquire. The net proceeds also are to be used to retire outstanding balances under the company's credit facility and for general corporate purposes.
The hotels are to be acquired in three separate transactions for $89.25 million in cash and $29.5 million in operating partnership units.
